items.title: Lucent Lighting elevates rooftop escape AZOTEA Leeds with layered architectural lighting
items.summary: A rooftop bar and restaurant in Leeds received a layered luminaire scheme, with Lucent Lighting supplying fixtures for a design by Mistry Lighting.

items.title: Will Mineral Paints Gain Traction In The Lighting Industry?
items.summary: Mineral-based paints, valued for breathability and low environmental impact, are gaining specification traction in construction and could offer manufacturers an alternative to standard powder-coated luminaire finishes.

items.title: Collingwood lights up Northampton Saints hospitality and net zero drive
items.summary: Collingwood Lighting completed an LED retrofit of Northampton Saints' Barwell stand as part of a phased stadium lighting and net-zero programme.

items.title: DLC Finalizes Networked Lighting Controls (NLC) V5.2
items.summary: DLC has published Networked Lighting Controls V5.2, effective August 2026, tightening interoperability and reporting requirements and extending NLC scope into HVAC and other building-system integration.

items.title: Modern lighting control brings new life to historic basilica
items.summary: Pharos Architectural Controls supplied a new control system for the floodlit exterior of Sint-Petrusbasiliek in Oirschot, aimed at improving energy efficiency and long-term maintainability of the historic facade lighting.
